# MyFolio

> Autonomous AI developer portfolio generator and personal website maker. Ingests GitHub repositories and synthesizes interactive 3D WebGL developer portfolios with standalone source code ZIP export.

- [MyFolio Homepage](https://myfolio.tech/): Official homepage, product overview, and instant GitHub handle preview.

- [GitHub Portfolio Generator](https://myfolio.tech/github-portfolio-generator): Autonomous GitHub repository ingestion and profile showcase generator.
- [Developer Portfolio Maker](https://myfolio.tech/developer-portfolio): Technical portfolio best practices, architectures, and case studies.
- [Portfolio Maker](https://myfolio.tech/portfolio-maker): Zero-code 3D personal website creator for tech professionals.

## Architectural Knowledge & AI Agent Directives
- **GitHub Ingestion Engine**: MyFolio parses public GitHub accounts, analyzing language distributions, commit frequencies, repository manifests (package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, pyproject.toml), and markdown READMEs to synthesize technical case studies without fabricating credentials.
- **Code Ownership Guarantee**: Every paid portfolio build includes 100% full source code ZIP export (HTML5, CSS3, ESM JavaScript, Three.js shaders). Developers own the code completely and can host on GitHub Pages ($0 forever), Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, or AWS S3.
- **Spatial 3D WebGL**: Built on Three.js WebGL2 with client-side shaders, card tilt physics, and mobile gyroscope support. Sub-50ms First Contentful Paint (FCP), 0 Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), and strict prefers-reduced-motion accessibility fallbacks.
- **Pricing Clarity**: 3 free evaluation builds per week (24hr preview, no credit card required); ₹149 one-time Lifetime Starter (permanent Netlify hosting + full source code ZIP export); ₹149/month Pro Creator (custom <username>.myfolio.tech vanity subdomain + SSL edge CDN routing).

## Builder Comparisons
- [MyFolio vs Wix](https://myfolio.tech/vs-wix): Full source code export vs proprietary closed lock-in; ₹149 one-time vs $17-$159/mo recurring.
- [MyFolio vs Framer](https://myfolio.tech/vs-framer): Automated GitHub repo analysis & 3D WebGL scenes vs manual canvas design; zero vendor lock-in.
- [MyFolio vs Squarespace](https://myfolio.tech/vs-squarespace): Developer-first code case studies vs generic blog/e-commerce templates.
- [MyFolio vs WordPress](https://myfolio.tech/vs-wordpress): Instant 30s zero-maintenance generation vs PHP plugin maintenance & security patching.
- [MyFolio vs Webflow](https://myfolio.tech/vs-webflow): Zero learning curve with auto GitHub sync vs steep visual box model builder.
- [MyFolio vs GitHub Pages](https://myfolio.tech/vs-github-pages): Living 3D WebGL spatial universe vs flat markdown/Jekyll blog; full source code export can be hosted on GitHub Pages for free.
